unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #33 on veris-ai/cookbook: an additive Nano (XNO) settle leg next to the Stripe MCP payment link, in the Catalog Agent's own shape (create_nano_invoice + verify_nano_block, payee-binds verification, exact raw math). The gap it closes: an agent buying on behalf of someone has no card to enter and stops at the Stripe link; Nano needs no card, no processor, no identity check, and settles in ~1s at zero fee. Offered to open it as a PR adapted to src/agent.js and mcp.js. https://github.com/veris-ai/cookbook/issues/33
